newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways shares, notes suspended.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways shares, notes suspended.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Monday it suspended trading in Payless Cashways Inc's common stock and 9.125 percent notes due April 15 2003.
The exchange said it would apply to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issues, because the company no longer complies with some of its listing criteria.

Payless has less than $12 million in net tangible assets available to its common stock and has not averaged a $600,000 net income in the last three years, the exchange said. It added Payless recently filed for bankruptcy protection under Chapter 11.
